goal: Keep the standalone image, video, and writing workspaces visually aligned under one Dianchi Agent toolbox header.

acceptance_criteria.description: All three workspaces show Dianchi Agent Toolbox at the left without the retired Dianchi Intelligence and Local Studio logo block.
The image, video, and writing mode controls use an equal-width centered three-column navigation so active states do not shift between pages.
Image generation parameter labels share fixed rows and the same horizontal text inset as their corresponding controls.
